VAR

    DrainPump AT %QX0.1 : BOOL;    (* Output: Drain Pump *)
    FillAlarm AT %QX0.2 : BOOL;    (* Output: Fill Alarm *)
END_VAR

VAR

    InPhase : TON;
    LastPhase : INT := -1;
END_VAR

(* Initialize the phase timer to reset every time the phase changes *)
InPhase(IN := (Phase = LastPhase), PT := T#2m);
LastPhase := Phase;

(* Main Control Logic *)
CASE Phase OF
    0:  (* Idle Phase *)
        IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 1;  (* Start Filling *)
        ELSE IF HighFloat THEN Phase := 4; (* Start Alarm *)
        END_IF;
    1:  (* Filling Phase *)
        IF HighFloat THEN Phase := 4;  (* Stop Filling, Start Alarm *)
        ELSE IF InPhase.Q THEN Phase := 4;  (* Stop Filling if timer exceeded *)
        END_IF;
    2:  (* Settling Phase *)
        IF InPhase.ET >= T#10s THEN Phase := 3; (* Start Draining *)
        END_IF;
    3:  (* Draining Phase *)
        IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 0;  (* Stop Draining, Start Filling *)
        ELSE IF InPhase.ET >= T#10s THEN Phase := 4; (* Stop Draining if timer exceeded *)
        END_IF;
    4:  (* Alarm Phase *)
        Phase := 4;  (* Stay here *)
END_CASE;

(* Output Control *)
FillValve := (Phase = 1);
DrainPump := (Phase = 3);
FillAlarm := (Phase = 4);
